That was a sample JWT (from jwt.io), not a Twilio Auth Token. A Twilio Auth Token is exactly **32 hex characters** (like `9a4b...8c2d`). The JWT you pasted is 172 characters and starts with `eyJ`.

Here is the direct path to the correct value:

**https://console.twilio.com/us1/account/keys-credentials/credentials**

On that page, find the **LIVE CREDENTIALS** section and copy the **Auth Token** (the 32-character hex string, not a JWT).

Once you paste the correct 32-char hex token, I will test it and send the SMS to 561-644-3503 within 30 seconds.
